changes.title: Mobile categories and detail screens
changes.reason: Choose a settings category first, then work in its dedicated screen.
changes.beforeText: The reviewed proposal puts a category dropdown above the settings content.
changes.afterText: Settings opens a category list. Each category opens its own detail route with a parent Settings control and a separate close button.
changes.context: Implements the exported note. Category selection, returning to categories, browser Back/Forward, direct links, settings-search focus, bookmark search preservation, and Escape were verified. Desktop keeps its sidebar. The first comparison shows category selection; the second shows detail content.

changes.title: Airy homepage controls
changes.reason: Keep the soft palette with a small increase in contrast.
changes.beforeText: The reviewed proposal uses neutral-colored homepage glyphs.
changes.afterText: Corner icons use lavender with slightly lower lightness. Search keeps its white glyph on a subtly deeper pink button.
changes.context: Implements the exported note to preserve the airy feel. The mountain scene, clock, and collapsed-search behavior are preserved. Captures differ in time; the earlier proposal includes no development overlays.

changes.title: Stronger section headings
changes.reason: Separate page headings from settings labels at a glance.
changes.beforeText: Section titles use the same large-text size as other interface labels.
changes.afterText: A shared 24px heading token clarifies the section hierarchy while preserving Quicksand.
changes.context: The crops include nearby unchanged controls. Sidebar selection and mobile navigation are separate decisions.

changes.title: Distinct selected section
changes.reason: Distinguish the current settings section from ordinary hover.
changes.beforeText: The selected sidebar item uses the same gray surface as hover.
changes.afterText: The selected item uses the existing lavender surface token.

changes.title: One focused empty state
changes.reason: Keep the first-keybind message and action together.
changes.beforeText: An empty card and a separate Add keybind button feel disconnected.
changes.afterText: A keyboard icon, existing message, and Add keybind button form one centered group.
changes.context: Also shows the separate mobile navigation and heading proposals. Adding a keybind and returning to the empty state were verified.

changes.title: Readable disabled Save
changes.reason: Keep the unavailable action identifiable while the form is incomplete.
changes.beforeText: White text and reduced opacity make the disabled Save label almost disappear.
changes.afterText: A muted text token and quiet surface keep Save readable and visibly disabled.
changes.context: Mobile form actions also use 44px targets. This changes presentation only; validation and disabled behavior are preserved.

changes.title: Theme-aware search placeholder
changes.reason: Keep the search hint legible in dark mode.
changes.beforeText: The placeholder uses the browser default gray.
changes.afterText: The placeholder uses the existing secondary text token at full opacity.
changes.context: The Before capture was taken after the section chooser was implemented, before this final placeholder adjustment.

verification.scope: Local guest mode. Signed-in account and wallpaper flows were not exercised.
checks: All five mobile categories and return paths
Browser Back/Forward and direct category routes
Search result focuses its matching setting
Bookmark search query survives a trip to categories
Escape returns from detail to categories
English and Traditional Chinese, light and dark themes
